notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
We are proud to finally announce the official release date for Shelf Life! It’s been a long and challenging development journey, but the final hours are upon us. We want to sincerely thank you for your support, feedback and patience throughout the process. We believe the full release will be worth the wait and bring you plenty of entertainment. A special thank you is also due for our playtesters Epic and Vince, your insights have been insanely helpful.

It’s been a long year of development, especially for a game that was only supposed to take 6 months to make. Along the way we faced many hurdles, from broken computers to academic deadlines to personal losses, but these challenges only strengthened our resolve to deliver something truly special.

Mark your calendars, Shelf Life launches on December 22nd.

This is just the beginning, so keep an eye out for our next project. Be sure to join the Bongwater Productions discord to stay up to date on our future projects and if you like what we’ve done so far, we’d be incredibly grateful if you shared the game with your friends.
Let’s celebrate this enormous milestone! Thank you for being a part of the journey, we can’t wait to show you what’s next.

Happy Smoking ːweedːːweedːːweedː,
Bongwater Productions Development Team

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Although progress has been slow, we want to thank you for your continued support :)
We know we said this last time, but THIS is the final update before the game is finally finished, and it includes numerous improvements and fixes across the game as a whole.

Baton
We thought the buildup in the first few levels was lacklustre, because you are immediately given a gun, killing much suspense and tension. Now instead of getting a gun first thing, you get a baton, which is not only slower than the pistol's melee attack, but does less damage. You now get the gun in the Eggs HQ level. Hopefully this makes the first level more of a challenge.

Cables
Our art guy found a plugin which lets him create really good looking cables with minimal performance hit, and he kind of went nuts with it. These cables are scattered like webbing throughout the server rooms, really making it fun to look at. Below are some highlights.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44928002/bb9ae499dbfbab41536e52089320855ec198cbf6.png

Performance
Previously, the game would need to run at quarter resolution, using TSR as an upscaler to hit 60fps on most systems, after this update, the game runs significantly better and can reach full resolution.

 Previously, the game used unreal engine's virtual shadowmaps, which had an extreme impact on performance. Now the game uses standard shadow maps by default.
 We have optimised the lighting on levels, removing all overlapping stationary lights we could find, which means more of the shadowmaps are baked, instead of being calculated dynamically, every frame.
 We changed the post processing and lumen settings to be much faster.


Menu
The menu has been improved, and is easier to see on white or black backgrounds. 

 Added FOV settings
 Added the option to enable motion blur
 Added option to reset individual options to default values, instead of every setting


BUGS

 Lizard eyes were absurdly bright in dark areas, changed the eye shader to glow less, this is more of an art thing but its too small to put anywhere else lol
 There was a bug with turrets, making them tank the games performance when destroyed with an explosive. this is no longer a problem
 Lizards no longer get stuck after spitting


Again, we are sorry for the pace at which updates are coming out, but we've brainstormed some really cool ideas for the final boss fight within Ron's mind, thinking about of all of the cool stuff we would be able to do that wouldn't be possible inside a realistic setting.
We're feeling confident that the final boss fight will make you laugh, cry and possibly get Bongwater Productions sued for defamation. You'll dive into the mind of this totally made up CEO (who is not representative of any particular billionaire you may have seen on the news lately) and unravel his ego like a cat with a ball of yarn. This is our first big project as a team, and we know that there's a lot that we can improve on in the future but we have a good feeling you'll be entertained by the finale.

Happy smoking,
Bongwater team.

notes.title: Early Access Update 2
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

First off we want to apologize for the delay. We've been working hard to get Shelf Life fully released for everyone to enjoy, and we're exited to announce that our second and final major patch is now live!

These past 2 months have been a bit rough. One of our devs computers died, leaving is with just 2 Developers. It slowed progress more than we expected, but we've kept pushing through and the game is turning out even better than we had hoped. We can't give a solid release date yet but rest assured it's coming very soon!

In the meantime we hope you enjoy the latest patch. Here's what's new:

New Level - DUM Tunnels: Navigate a series of tight tunnels only large enough for a single self driving car, sneak past sentry turrets and solve puzzles while blasting through an army of Bucklezergs lizard men to reach Ron during his computer-assisted therapy session. (The boss cheaped out on the self driving cars hazard recognition cameras so don't expect them to try and avoid hitting you.)
 New Weapon - The Fungiblizer: Burn through your enemies (and your life savings) with this NFT engraving gun.
Massive Overhaul of Eggs HQ: We know Eggs HQ had some big performance and gameplay issues, so we completely overhauled it. The levels performance has been massively optimized and the level design has also been improved.
Music: Enjoy the awesome soundtrack our composer made for Shelf Life, With new music tracks playing in every level.
New enemy models, sounds and animations: Enemies now look more lizard-like and behave in a more believable way, with new models sounds and animations.
AI Enhancements: Enemies are now smarter. They'll chase you better, hide from you better and put up a tougher fight overall.
Difficulty Settings: Players can now choose from different difficulty settings that affect enemy frequency and ammunition drops.
New Main Menu: We overhauled the main menu and setting page, complete with a level selector and a reset save button for if the game get's corrupted between patches.
Even more miscellaneous bug fixes.


We know this patch took longer than expected, but we believe both this update and the full release will be worth the wait. Thank you all so much for your continued support and understanding. If you want to stay updated on Shelf Life, get access to playtests or learn about our future projects, be sure to join our Discord linked in the games main menu.

Thanks again,
Bongwater Productions.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: We noticed health occasionally reverted to zero at the start of some levels. Added in footstep sounds and a few other small improvements. Unless our playtesters find some more bugs expect another level in the next Patch.

notes.title: Early Access Patch 1
notes.content:
We've spent the last 2 weeks fixing bugs and adding some improvements to the opening levels. These include:
Added body for player in the target suit.
Added more NPC's roaming the office.
Added Armor for the target suit
Added collision to door frames.
Added sounds and sparks to servers once power and heating systems are overloaded in Eggs HQ.
Added footstep sounds to the player
Added interaction sounds.
Added Skip intro option
Added a link to the teams discord.
Added Vsync
Updated main menu and settings.
NPC's now look at you when talking.
Improved cutscenes and level transitions.
Streamlined levels
Fixed bug where you couldn't enter armor testing room.
Fixed bug where health and ammo would reset after moving to next level.
Fixed bug that prevented settings from saving

If you encounter any bugs please let us know in the community Hub or on our discord linked in the main menu. We're looking for play testers so if you're interested please let us know.
